source: Anthropic published API pricing, as documented in the claude-api reference bundled with Claude Code (skill version cached 2026-06-24). Cache multipliers from the prompt-caching documentation in the same bundle.
note: These are list prices for the first-party Claude API. They are not what every account pays: Bedrock and Vertex are priced separately, batch requests are half price, and Sonnet 5 has an introductory rate through 2026-08-31. Change the numbers here rather than editing code.

cache_multipliers._comment: Multipliers applied to the model's INPUT price. A cache read costs a tenth of an ordinary input token; a 5-minute cache write costs 1.25x; a 1-hour cache write costs 2x. Treating cache tokens as ordinary input tokens overstates reads by 10x and understates 1-hour writes by 40%.

local._comment: Cost per GPU-second for locally hosted models. Zero by default because a GPU you already own has no marginal per-second price. Set it to an amortised rate (card price divided by expected lifetime hours, plus electricity) if you want local stages to carry a dollar figure.
